data.raw_text: LOOK: An "Impeach Sara" protest breaks out in front of the House of Representatives in Quezon City ahead of the scheduled plenary vote on Monday, May 11, 2026. Under the Constitution, at least 106 votes, representing one-third of the chamber, are required to officially elevate the case to the Senate, which will convene as an impeachment court for a formal trial. | via Jonathan Cellona, ABS-CBN

‘IMPEACH SARA NOW’

LOOK: Members of the Akbayan Partylist gather in protest outside the House of Representatives in Quezon City on Monday, May 11, as Congress is set to begin plenary deliberations on the impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte.

The demonstrators are calling for the Vice President’s removal over allegations of undeclared wealth, suspicious multi-billion-peso bank transactions, and the controversial use of confidential funds. | 📷: Grig C. Montegrande, Philippine Daily Inquirer

'IMPEACH SARA, SEE YOU AT THE SENATE!'

Nagsagawa ng rally ngayong Lunes, Mayo 11, ang Akbayan Party-list, sa pangunguna ni Akbayan Rep. Perci Cendaña, kasama rin ang mga tagasuporta ng grupo, sa labas ng Kamara de Representantes sa Batasan Pambansa sa Quezon City.

Bitbit ang mga placards, binigyang-diin ng grupo ang kanilang panawagan sa Senado na gampanan ang tungkulin nito at ituloy ang paglilitis sa impeachment case laban kay Vice President Sara Duterte, na inaasahang mai-impeach ng mga kongresista ngayong araw.

Courtesy: Akbayan Rep. Perci Cendaña/Facebook

LOOK | On May 11, 2026, women’s group GABRIELA staged a protest at the Meralco branch in España, Manila, denouncing what they described as inhumane electricity rate hikes amid the ongoing economic crisis.

The group condemned Meralco for allegedly extracting excessive profits from low-income households, while also criticizing what they called corruption under the Marcos Jr. administration, citing the continued burden on the public through a 12% VAT on basic goods and services.

📸: GABRIELA via Edd Castro
